digest.component_or_area: CI evaluation harness for structured output baseline
propositions: A CI harness under tests/external/ must capture raw LLM replies for each (provider, model, directive variant) cell via workflow_dispatch with live API keys scoped per-provider arm and budget-capped to prevent over-billing.

The harness scores raw replies deterministically: parse success (current parser vs new selection+sentinel parser) and layout-class distribution (prose, fenced, multi_object, quoted-JSON) against committed E2 fixture goldens.
Missing API credentials must be recorded as 'unmeasured' and skipped without job failure; the credential-absent path must be unit-testable in Python logic, not YAML conditionals.

The sentinel directive demonstrably improves parse success and normalizes raw-output layout to 100% prose on anthropic and bedrock (fenced/multi_object → 0), with gains across all three provider arms.

Unit test suite must validate scorer reproduction on committed E2 fixtures, credential-skip logic, call-budget enforcement before network requests, and workflow registration in the locked naming table.
One operator-triggered workflow_dispatch run (max_calls=120) completed successfully across all 3 provider arms; artifacts (raw replies + score_table.json) are linked as evidence.
